cluster_name.description: Optional cluster name filter; use an empty string to query all clusters.

lookback.description: Lookback window as ES|QL time span text (e.g. 15 minutes, 1 hour, 24 hours).

configuration.query:
FROM .monitoring-es-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= NOW() - TO_TIMEDURATION(?lookback)
| WHERE metricset.name == "cluster_stats"
| WHERE elasticsearch.cluster.name IS NOT NULL AND elasticsearch.cluster.stats.status IS NOT NULL
| WHERE elasticsearch.cluster.stats.status != "green"
| WHERE (?cluster_name == "" OR elasticsearch.cluster.name == ?cluster_name)
| STATS samples = COUNT(), last_seen = MAX(@timestamp), node_count = MAX(elasticsearch.cluster.stats.nodes.count), shards_count = MAX(elasticsearch.cluster.stats.indices.shards.count), primaries_count = MAX(elasticsearch.cluster.stats.indices.shards.primaries) BY bucket = DATE_TRUNC(10 minutes, @timestamp), elasticsearch.cluster.name, elasticsearch.cluster.stats.status
| SORT bucket DESC, samples DESC
| LIMIT 50

description: Track cluster-health periods where the monitoring stream reports yellow or red.
